packs.name: 工作常用短语动词
packs.intro: 美国同事说话大量用短语动词，而不是书面词。每句都是工作场景里的完整句子，note 里是动词和意思。

phrases.t: The driver will pick up the container at two.
phrases.note: pick up = 提取、接走

phrases.t: Can you drop off the empty at gate three?
phrases.zh: 你能把空柜放到三号门吗？
phrases.note: drop off = 放下、送到

phrases.t: Please check in at the guard shack first.
phrases.note: check in = 登记报到

phrases.t: You need to fill out this form.
phrases.note: fill out = 填写（表格）

phrases.t: We're running out of seals.
phrases.note: run out of = 用完、耗尽

phrases.t: He didn't show up for his shift today.
phrases.note: show up = 出现、到场

phrases.t: Back it up a little more.
phrases.note: back up = 倒车；也有“备份、支持”的意思

phrases.t: Line up the trucks along the fence.
phrases.note: line up = 排队、排成一行

phrases.t: Hold on, let me check the system.
phrases.note: hold on = 稍等

phrases.t: I'll swing by the office after lunch.
phrases.zh: 午饭后我顺路去趟办公室。
phrases.note: swing by = 顺路过去一下

phrases.t: I'll follow up with the dispatcher.
phrases.zh: 我会跟调度再跟进一下。
phrases.note: follow up (with) = 跟进

phrases.t: We need to figure out where it went.
phrases.zh: 我们得搞清楚它去哪了。
phrases.note: figure out = 弄明白、想出

phrases.t: Let's sort out the paperwork first.
phrases.note: sort out = 整理、解决

phrases.t: Hand over the keys when you're done.
phrases.note: hand over = 移交、交出

phrases.t: Can you set up the new scanner?
phrases.zh: 你能把新扫描器装好吗？
phrases.note: set up = 安装、设置

phrases.t: Don't forget to clock out.
phrases.note: clock out = 下班打卡；clock in = 上班打卡

phrases.t: Can you fill in for Mike tomorrow?
phrases.zh: 你明天能替一下 Mike 吗？
phrases.note: fill in for = 代班、顶替

phrases.t: The truck broke down on the freeway.
phrases.note: break down = 抛锚、坏掉

phrases.t: Write down the container number for me.
phrases.note: write down = 写下来、记下

phrases.t: We're backed up at the gate again.
phrases.note: backed up = 堵住、积压

packs.name: 生活常用短语动词
packs.intro: 生活里最常用的短语动词，美剧和邻居聊天都离不开。每句都是完整例句，note 里是动词和意思。

phrases.t: I'll look into it this weekend.
phrases.note: look into = 调查、研究

phrases.t: Stop putting off the dentist.
phrases.note: put off = 拖延、推迟

phrases.t: She came up with a great idea.
phrases.note: come up with = 想出（主意、办法）

phrases.t: It took me a week to get over the cold.
phrases.zh: 我花了一周才从感冒中恢复。
phrases.note: get over = 从…中恢复、克服

phrases.t: He turned down the job offer.
phrases.note: turn down = 拒绝；也指调小音量

phrases.t: Our flight takes off at nine.
phrases.note: take off = 起飞；也指脱下、请假

phrases.t: I ran into an old friend at Costco.
phrases.zh: 我在 Costco 碰到一个老朋友。
phrases.note: run into = 偶遇

phrases.t: We ended up eating at home.
phrases.note: end up = 最后（落得）…

phrases.t: Can you pick me up from the station?
phrases.note: pick (someone) up = 开车去接某人

phrases.t: I need to figure out my taxes.
phrases.note: figure out = 弄清楚

phrases.t: We just moved in last month.
phrases.note: move in = 搬入；move out = 搬出

phrases.t: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
phrases.note: cut down on = 减少

phrases.t: Let's eat out tonight.
phrases.note: eat out = 在外面吃饭

phrases.t: Don't give up, you're almost there.
phrases.note: give up = 放弃

phrases.t: I'll look after your dog this weekend.
phrases.note: look after = 照顾

phrases.t: Please turn off the lights.
phrases.note: turn off = 关掉；turn on = 打开

phrases.t: We get along really well.
phrases.note: get along (with) = 相处融洽

phrases.t: I'm looking forward to the trip.
phrases.note: look forward to = 期待（后接名词或 -ing）

phrases.t: Let me think it over.
phrases.note: think over = 仔细考虑

packs.name: 职场客套话
packs.intro: 跟主管、办公室、调度沟通时的礼貌开场和收尾。语气友好又专业，是美国职场的润滑剂。

phrases.t: Sorry to bother you.
phrases.note: 开口找人时最常用

phrases.t: Quick question for you.
phrases.note: 非常口语，暗示不会占用太久

phrases.t: Do you have a minute?
phrases.zh: 你有空吗？/方便说两句吗？

phrases.t: Just to confirm, it's gate five, right?
phrases.zh: 确认一下，是五号门对吧？
phrases.note: Just to confirm 用来核对信息，很专业

phrases.t: I'll get back to you on that.
No worries.
phrases.note: 回应道歉或感谢都可以

phrases.t: My bad, I'll fix it.
phrases.note: My bad = 我的错，口语、随意

phrases.t: Heads up, the truck is running late.
phrases.note: Heads up = 提前提醒

phrases.t: Thanks for the heads up.
Let me know if you need anything.
I'm on it.
phrases.note: 表示马上处理，很干脆

phrases.t: Sounds good.
phrases.note: 职场最万能的同意回复

phrases.t: I'll keep you posted.
Could you walk me through it?
phrases.zh: 你能一步步给我讲讲吗？
phrases.note: walk someone through = 一步一步讲解

phrases.t: I appreciate your help.
phrases.note: 比 thanks 更正式一点

phrases.t: Sorry, could you say that again?
Got it, thanks.
I'll double-check and let you know.
phrases.zh: 我再核实一下然后告诉你。

packs.name: 南加州日常口语和俚语
packs.intro: 南加州人说话的特色：高速前加 the，五六月阴天有专名，年轻人有自己的俚语。note 标了俚语程度和使用人群。

phrases.t: Take the 10 to the 15, then get on the 210.
phrases.zh: 走 10 号转 15 号，再上 210。
phrases.note: 南加州说高速要加 the（the 10, the 210）；北加州一般不加 the。

phrases.t: The 60 is a parking lot right now.
phrases.zh: 60 号高速现在堵成停车场了。
phrases.note: a parking lot = 严重堵车，日常口语，各年龄都用。

phrases.t: It's just June gloom, it'll clear up by noon.
phrases.zh: 只是六月阴天，中午就晴了。
phrases.note: June gloom = 初夏沿海早上阴天，本地人都懂的说法。

phrases.t: May gray is lasting forever this year.
phrases.zh: 今年五月阴天怎么没完没了。
phrases.note: May gray = 五月阴天，与 June gloom 同类说法。

phrases.t: I'm so stoked for the weekend.
phrases.note: stoked = 超兴奋，冲浪文化来的，各年龄都用，轻度俚语。

phrases.t: That wave was gnarly.
phrases.note: gnarly = 厉害/很猛（也可指很糟），冲浪俚语，偏80-90年代风格。

phrases.t: This taco spot is legit.
phrases.note: legit = 正宗、靠谱，年轻人和中年人都常用。

phrases.t: That place is hella busy.
phrases.note: hella = very/非常，起源于北加州湾区，南加州也能听到，年轻人用，较随意。

phrases.t: This burrito is fire, no cap.
phrases.zh: 这个墨西哥卷绝了，不骗你。
phrases.note: fire = 超棒；no cap = 不吹牛/真的，Z世代俚语，年长人很少用。

phrases.t: Dude, that's sick!
phrases.note: sick = 很酷，年轻人俚语；dude 各年龄男女都常用。

phrases.t: We're going to the beach, wanna come?
phrases.zh: 我们去海滩，要一起来吗？
phrases.note: wanna = want to，口语缩读。

phrases.t: It's like ninety degrees out here.
phrases.note: like 作填充词很加州；温度是华氏度。

phrases.t: Santa Anas are blowing, so it's super dry.
phrases.note: Santa Ana winds = 秋季从内陆吹来的干热风，本地常识。

phrases.t: Let's grab In-N-Out on the way home.
phrases.zh: 回家路上去吃 In-N-Out 吧。
phrases.note: grab = 随便买点吃的，日常口语。

phrases.t: I'm down, let's do it.
phrases.note: I'm down = 我愿意参加，年轻人常用，轻度俚语。

phrases.t: It's not that far, like twenty minutes without traffic.
phrases.zh: 不算远，不堵车大概二十分钟。
phrases.note: 南加州人用时间而不是英里说距离。

phrases.t: That's a vibe.
phrases.note: a vibe = 很有感觉，年轻人俚语。

phrases.t: He's super chill.
phrases.note: chill = 随和、放松，各年龄都用。

packs.name: 新闻里常见的习语
packs.intro: 新闻、播客和财经报道里反复出现的习语。会说这些，听新闻会轻松很多。

phrases.t: Critics say it's a slippery slope.
phrases.zh: 批评者说这会一发不可收拾。
phrases.note: a slippery slope = 滑坡效应、一步错步步错

phrases.t: The storm was a wake-up call for the city.
phrases.zh: 这场风暴给城市敲响了警钟。
phrases.note: a wake-up call = 警钟

phrases.t: Can you give me a ballpark figure?
phrases.note: a ballpark figure = 粗略估计

phrases.t: All options are still on the table.
phrases.zh: 所有选项都还在考虑中。
phrases.note: on the table = 在讨论/考虑中

phrases.t: These cases are just the tip of the iceberg.
phrases.zh: 这些案例只是冰山一角。
phrases.note: the tip of the iceberg = 冰山一角

phrases.t: The two sides are back to square one.
phrases.note: back to square one = 回到原点

phrases.t: The company is in hot water again.
phrases.zh: 这家公司又惹上麻烦了。
phrases.note: in hot water = 陷入麻烦

phrases.t: Investors are taking a wait-and-see approach.
phrases.note: wait-and-see = 观望的

phrases.t: The deal fell through at the last minute.
phrases.zh: 交易在最后一刻告吹了。
phrases.note: fall through = 落空、告吹

phrases.t: Prices went through the roof.
phrases.note: go through the roof = 暴涨

phrases.t: The plan is still up in the air.
phrases.note: up in the air = 未定

phrases.t: Lawmakers kicked the can down the road.
phrases.zh: 议员们又把问题往后拖了。
phrases.note: kick the can down the road = 拖延问题

phrases.t: The market took a hit this week.
phrases.note: take a hit = 受到打击

phrases.t: It's a double-edged sword.
phrases.note: a double-edged sword = 双刃剑

phrases.t: Officials are under fire for the delay.
phrases.zh: 官员们因延误受到抨击。
phrases.note: under fire = 遭受批评

phrases.t: The two parties hammered out a deal.
phrases.note: hammer out = 经过艰苦谈判达成

phrases.t: Ports are feeling the pinch.
phrases.note: feel the pinch = 感受到（经济）压力

phrases.t: It's a game changer for the industry.
phrases.zh: 这对行业来说是颠覆性的。
phrases.note: a game changer = 改变格局的事物

packs.name: 闲聊万能句和接话
packs.intro: 听别人说话时及时接一句，对话就不会冷场。这些短句几乎在任何闲聊里都能用。

phrases.t: That makes sense.
No way!
phrases.note: 表示惊讶，语调上扬

phrases.t: Tell me about it.
phrases.note: 表示深有同感，不是真的要你讲

phrases.t: I hear you.
phrases.note: 表示理解对方感受

phrases.t: You got it.
phrases.note: 答应别人请求时用

phrases.t: Fair enough.
phrases.note: 接受对方的理由

phrases.t: Oh, really? How come?
phrases.note: How come = why，更口语

phrases.t: That's awesome, good for you.
I know, right?
phrases.note: 强烈附和，年轻人常用

phrases.t: Same here.
What have you been up to?
Not much, just working.
That's too bad, sorry to hear that.
phrases.zh: 太遗憾了，听到这个很难过。

phrases.t: You're telling me.
phrases.note: 表示“我太清楚了”，同 Tell me about it

phrases.t: Good point.
I'm not sure, to be honest.
Anyway, I gotta get going.
phrases.note: gotta = got to；用来自然结束对话

phrases.t: Catch you later.
phrases.note: 随意的道别
